newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia public servants strike to hit Victoria.
newsitem.headline: Australia public servants strike to hit Victoria.

text.p: Australian public servants, continuing rolling national strikes to protest against government labour reforms, will stop work in the state of Victoria on Tuesday.
The civil servants' main union, the Community and Public Sector Union, is staging half-day strikes around the country on an alternating basis, angry at job cuts and changes to conditions.

"Our members are escalating industrial action as they see the full extent of the cuts in jobs and their conditions unfold through agency negotiations," the union's state secretary, Sue Mountford, said in a statement.
